name: Proper Cloth
why: Open-spec custom shirting — 350 published fabrics, a 16-point fit algorithm.
origin: Seph Skerritt, NYC, 2008 — an engineer's custom shirting company built on published specs.
opview: Skerritt's stated belief: push shirt, fit, and fabric data back to the consumer.

notes.cotton: 350 published fabrics from Albini and Thomas Mason with open specs
notes.tech: a 16-point fit algorithm trained on tens of thousands of bodies
notes.murica: bought a 150-year-old Pennsylvania knitting mill to make its tees on American soil
notes.style: vintage-inspired in everything — the product, the shops, the photography; a total aesthetic commitment
notes.craft: bought and restarted the 1873 Mohnton knitting mill — the best possible 4; when owned make covers the wovens, 5 is automatic

cities: NYC — SoHo & Fifth Ave showrooms · online
